title: Insurance Claim Services Category Reassessment — PPE Difference
content:
Q. How is PPE priced in an Insurance Claim Services category reassessment supplement?

A. The PPE difference is set as follows: for a job dispatched at a Gray Water tier whose recorded category is category 3, the PPE technician-days billed multiplied by the difference between the Black Water PPE rate and the dispatch tier's PPE rate; for a job dispatched at a Clean Water tier whose recorded category is category 2 or category 3, one PPE technician-day per technician labor line billed at the PPE rate of the tier the recorded category selects; otherwise no PPE difference.

Q. Which rates apply?

A. The Black Water PPE rate is 46.20 per technician per day and the Gray Water PPE rate is 28.75, the same at Standard Loss and Large Loss. A Clean Water job recorded category 3 takes 46.20, recorded category 2 takes 28.75.

Q. What is counted on a Clean Water job?

A. Each technician labor line billed on the Water Damage Mitigation job counts as one PPE technician-day, whatever its hours.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Dispatched at | Recorded category | Records | PPE difference |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | category 3 | 7 PPE technician-days billed (dispatch tier rate 28.75) | 7 multiplied by 17.45 is 122.15 |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | category 3 | 6 technician labor lines | 6 multiplied by 46.20 is 277.20 |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | category 2 | 6 technician labor lines | 6 multiplied by 28.75 is 172.50 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | category 2 | any | none |
